summary.text: Kathleen Fogarty is a Democratic state representative who has represented District 35 in the Rhode Island House of Representatives since January 6, 2015 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: In the 2021-2022 legislative session Fogarty chaired the Special Legislation Committee and was also assigned to the Environment and Natural Resources Committee.
